title: The default-deadline test monkeypatches the global Date.now and process.stderr.…
description:
The default-deadline test monkeypatches the global Date.now and process.stderr.write. Both are correctly restored in a finally block and bun runs a file's tests serially, so this is safe today, but a shared withFakeClock helper under test/helpers/ would make the pattern reusable and harder to leak if the test is ever copied.

Source: cam/issue-358
